parsed.post: Significant breakthrough! Increasing DEPTH to 8 yielded a new best val_bpb of 0.848074. The capacity increase is clearly working. Now, I'll try to optimize the learning rate and batch size for this deeper architecture to see if we can drive the loss even lower before the final rounds.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH to 8 and slightly reducing MATRIX_LR and TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to stabilize training for the increased capacity.
